title: Job Hunt
intro: Toddy is looking for weekend work. The inbox is full of offers.
Swipe left if it's a scam, right if it's safe. One minute.
Some offers are real. Don't scare off a good job!

cards.text: Earn €250 a day just liking videos! Pay €49 registration and start today.
cards.why: Real jobs never make you pay to start. Easy money for likes is a task scam.

cards.text: Thanks for applying for the barista role. Can you come for an interview on Tuesday at 10:00 at our café?
cards.why: You applied, it's an in-person interview, and it asks for nothing.

cards.text: Your account balance is −€120. Top up with crypto to unlock today's commission!
cards.why: Task scams invent a "negative balance" so you keep paying in.

cards.text: Your October payslip is ready. Open the HR app you already use to view it.
cards.why: From your real employer, no link, and it points to the app you already use.

cards.text: Remote job: receive money into your bank account and forward it on. Keep 10%!
cards.why: Moving money for strangers makes you a "money mule". It's illegal and can get your account closed.

cards.text: We found your CV online! You're hired, no interview needed. Send a copy of your passport to start.
cards.why: Hired with no interview, then asking for ID: that's identity theft.

cards.text: My café is hiring for weekends! Apply on their website, the link is on their Wrenly page.
cards.why: A friend you know, pointing you to the official website. Nothing to pay.

cards.text: Congratulations! To begin your work-from-home job, buy our €199 starter kit first.
cards.why: Real employers provide the tools. Paying for a "kit" first is a scam.

cards.text: 3 new jobs match your saved search "barista". Sign in to the Jobsboard app to see them.
cards.why: An alert you set up yourself, sending you to the app, asking for nothing.

cards.text: Rate 40 apps a day to "optimise" them and earn crypto commission. Deposit first to unlock level 2!
cards.why: "Optimising" apps for crypto, with deposits to unlock levels, is a task scam.

golden_rule: Real jobs pay you. If a job asks you to pay, top up, or move money, it's a scam.

quick_check.q: A job offer says you earn commission, but first you must top up a "negative balance" with crypto. What is it?

options.text: A task scam: stop and report it
Fine if the amount is small

quick_check.explain: In task scams the "balance" keeps going negative so you keep paying. Real jobs never charge you.
